title: PeopleSoft Studio's Query model replays Windows Query's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/queryCriteria.test.ts rebuilds Windows Query's captured saves (qcr, qnm, qjn, qag, qhv, qex, qsq, qun, qxl, qed; HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's Query document and requires Windows Query's rows exactly; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3).

observations.observation: Run of src/test/queryCriteria.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 18 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: native criteria captures qcr02-qcr10 replay exactly as one typed criteria operation
native first saves qcr01 and qnm01 are reproduced from a new document
numeric and date constants and prompts replay qnm02-qnm04
a date between stores two date constants as Windows Query does (8.61.15 XX_QRY_C1_AD)
typed criteria refuse uncalibrated and inconsistent shapes
native joins qjn01-qjn04 replay: standard, criteria after a join, left outer and related effective-dated
native aggregates, HAVING and DISTINCT replay qag01-qag05
native date aggregate replays qag06: Max on START_DT; a WHERE criterion on it is refused
native expression-column criterion replays qex04: the expression column is \#N
native HAVING OR replays qhv01: COMBTYPE 5
native nested subquery replays qsq03: existing subqueries keep their selects, the nested one is appended
native subquery in a union query replays qsq04: appended after the union select
native translates and base effective dating replay qxl01-qxl02
native effective-date operators replay qed01-qed06: the EFFDT criterion changes operator in place
every native capture round-trips: its described criteria replace themselves exactly
